helmet_profile_sampling_audit_v1.scope: Diagnostic only, exact baker smooth source normals at deterministic triangle centers. Cumulative and independent visibility-filter survivor counts locate evidence loss; selected RGB means are source-color diagnostics, not albedo or texture correctness. No thresholds relaxed, no source images exported, no assets modified.

color_correction.scope: Approximate affine response fit in assumed linearized sRGB, same-time surface correspondences, robust loss, fixed reference camera and bounded coefficients. Not spectral/colorimetric calibration or recovered albedo; clipping, pose error and view-dependent lighting remain. Exposure gain is shared acrossRGB with bounded±2EV, chromatic correction is limited to exp(±.15), and black-level bias is shared acrossRGB within±.01 assumed-linear units. This reduces artificial chroma in dark lining; it does not recover missing source detail or guarantee registration.

helmet_profile_local_consensus_texture_v.scope: Real original native PNG multiframe/multicamera UV appearance, two best-angle observations per camera then channelwise weighted median across up to16 samples. Positive candidate labels, native mesh self-depth and surface-class agreement, conservative body depth and hand-unknown exclusion. Unobserved texels explicitly marked and repaired by nearby observed same-class colors or class medians/design fallbacks. Not calibrated albedo, relighting or proof of correct geometry/texture; pose/segmentation/lighting errors remain. Requires actual real/novel-view rendering and held-out evaluation. No raw footage/model weights published.

texel_consensus.scope: Each camera contributes at most one best-angle representative to an unweighted median reference, so one high-angle view cannot dominate the consistency vote. Retain samples close to that reference only with enough distinct cameras agreeing; rejected/single-view texels remain unknown and any later fill is inference. No stage restriction, white-shell or dark-lining color gate; common multi-camera registration bias can survive. Fixed lighting/exposure/pose ambiguity remains.

color_correction.scope: Controlled response substitution, no acceptance claim. Reciprocal gains from a completed frozen human linear-reference observation fit, shared across human and helmet. These estimates inherit human model/lighting bias and are not measured camera calibration. Human convention observed/model is inverted for baker observed->reference; same reference camera fixes gauge.

transferred_camera_response_check_v1.scope: Checks actual saved gains equal inverse human observed/model convention, zero bias and identity reference. Only stale descriptive metadata corrected; no texture/sample/geometry change. Does not prove physical response accuracy.

local_texture_controls_input_comparison_.scope: Same calibrated8 input cameras and explicit pixel-center1008x756 rendering, Gaussian-center mesh culling and saved neural decoder. Candidate SAM person/accepted helmet masks define FIXED source-foreground RGB support and eroded11pixel SSIM interior; missing rendered foreground counts as RGB error. White target background used only to avoid raw background contamination in SSIM windows. Mask IoUs include predicted leaks, separate visible body/helmet masks; unknown helmet annotations skipped. No per-candidate exposure fitting or color gains applied, so camera-response/light differences remain. Sampled or all-frame scope explicit. Input-view diagnostics only, not independent novel-view truth or contact certification; original-derived private sheets must not be published.

local_texture_controls_pipeline_v1.scope: Controlled candidate renders; same geometry/human/poses, different texture evidence selection or camera response only. No adoption or quality assertion.

scope: Same fixed human/geometry/object motion, global-frame reliability vs local cross-time texel consensus, plus independent human-response substitution.
